en.headline: Multi-agency drill tests cross-border ambulance handover at new Huanggang Port
en.dek: Fire Services, Customs, Immigration, the Department of Health and the Government Property Agency simulated a patient transfer from the mainland via the joint one-stop lane on Tuesday.
body: Multiple government departments conducted a joint drill at the new Huanggang Port on 25 August to test the cross-border transfer of a patient by ambulance between Shenzhen and Hong Kong. The exercise simulated a patient being transported from the mainland to the port via the joint one-stop vehicle lane and handed over to Hong Kong ambulance crew.

The Fire Services Department, Customs, the Immigration Department, the Department of Health and the Government Property Agency worked together according to established contingency procedures to complete patient handover, clearance, risk assessment and ambulance transfer. Officials said the departments maintained close communication throughout to ensure a safe and efficient transfer.

The Fire Services Department said the drill helped participating units familiarise themselves with the new port’s handover process and strengthened inter-departmental coordination for future cross-border medical transports. Customs added that it would continue preparations for the port’s opening.

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸多部門演練深港救護車跨境病人交接
zh.dek: 消防、海關、入境處、衞生署及政府產業署周二模擬病人經聯合一站式車道由內地轉交港方救護人員。
body: 多個政府部門於8月25日在新皇崗口岸舉行深港救護車跨境病人交接聯合演練，模擬一名病人由內地以救護車運送至口岸，通過「聯合一站式」車道，轉交港方救護人員。
消防處、海關、入境事務處、衞生署及政府產業署按照既定應變程序，順利完成病人交收、通關、風險評估及救護車轉運等工作。各部門人員全程保持密切溝通，確保病人在安全、迅速及最合適的安排下完成跨境轉送。
消防處表示，透過是次演練，各參與部門進一步熟習新皇崗口岸的交接流程，提升跨部門協作與應變能力。海關則強調會繼續全力推進口岸各項準備工作，爭取早日順利開通。
